title: P104: exclude 999 single-departure grade-seven return reroutes
body:
## A bounded obstruction for a proposed cheaper return
Replace one of nine native three-MOVE downhill paths by a single rank-seven transfer to one of 111 existing dimension-one charts. Permit arbitrary recoding at that chart’s surviving later departure, a fresh zero-chart decoder, and terminal decoders with complete observation histories. Hold all other interior operations, contacts and clocks fixed. All 999 choices fail. The proof traces two formal discrepancies to independent terminal stocks and permits nonlinear binary payloads. A literal 1→8 control sends the exact required first field and retains rank 630, yet 54 output rows change.

## Price and scope
At κ=0.00389046, six feasible fusions of grades 1+2+4, or seven of 1+5+1, would clear both raw and 268-factor price tests. The 999 failures yield zero feasible placements. Two altered departures, multiple simultaneously redesigned chains and wider channels remain open.

## Inputs, overlap and replay
Main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; #8027 fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4; #8041 05f6172d4d9487090fa24c75137a7c60e6fcd67e. #8043 screens individual frozen slots. #8046 constructs nine direct-to-zero returns at grade eight. The present class changes a whole chain, its endpoint and a surviving receiver payload. Shared #7257 CI prerequisite 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026.

CPython 3.12: python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-seven-grade-returns. Exact committed replay passed in 6.09 s. An independent dual-trace implementation checks every witness and 111 rational projectors; corrupted donor, source and duplicate-witness controls are rejected. Next test: provide a second physically usable outlet and prove the displaced reader accepts it. Ali Romman supplied the operator, DreamingOfClouds the motivating toolkit, and Clear1nsight prepared the result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
